name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F2-kept-twice
old: if (last && same(last, entry)) return list.length !== had;
note: A word that changes nothing kept a second time - on the relay and every client alike, so the bodies agree and only the no-twice pin sees it.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F2-relay-keeps-the-duplicate
note: The relay's half of the finding: a second 'deep now' kept after a surfacing still to come is dropped.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F2-client-asks-before-the-rule
old: if (!onTimeline(modes, { at: w.at, m: w.m }, sameMode)) return s;
new:
if (s.modes.some((d) => d.at === w.at && d.m === w.m)) return s;
      if (!onTimeline(modes, { at: w.at, m: w.m }, sameMode)) return s;
note: The client's half, as it shipped: the word taken for one it had before the rule dropped what the relay dropped.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F4-judged-however-late
note: A landing seen after it landed (or past a stalled frame) judged against where my ship is now.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F4-late-venom-left-off
note: The venom of a spit seen late never laid on the water.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F5-far-share-brought
old: if (near) { f.max += share; f.hp += share * frac; }
note: A newcomer's `in` from past ENGAGE_R brings her share into its health at once.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F5-far-seen-now
note: A far newcomer counted at the fight the moment she joins - the next beat brings her share in.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F5-far-not-retired
note: A far newcomer's share, never brought in, taken out of its health by the next beat.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F6-slain-let-go
new: const over = today.find(([, f]) => (f.fell && f.said && f.told) || (f.gone && !f.fell));
note: A slain fight let go for another site's while its waters stand open - an `in` that missed the hub's word bears it again at full health.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F6-one-ship-idle
note: A lone ship's fight (no part yet) idle - let go for a forged site's.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F7-ram-past-its-reach
note: The ram chosen at ships its lane ends short of.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F8-every-fight-written
new:
await this._serpentSave(id, f, now, false);
        if (f.fell && !f.said) await this._serpentFall(id, f, now);
note: Every kept fight written again on every checkpoint - a slain one's hundred kilobytes every 2 s beside a live one.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F8-sounding-unwritten
note: Its sounding left to the next checkpoint, which never comes for a still fight.

name: AUDIT-SERPENT-2-F9-made-at-every-ask
note: The shots' targets made again at every ask of the frame.
